newsitem.title: USA: House of Fabrics CEO Larkins steps aside.
newsitem.headline: House of Fabrics CEO Larkins steps aside.

text.p: House of Fabrics Inc, said on Friday Gary Larkins will step aside as president and chief executive officer and assume the newly created position of vice chairman.
Larkins, 53, will continue as chief executive until a successor is named, and he will be active on the board's search committee, the company said in a statement.

House of Fabrics, an owner and operator of 267 retail fabric and craft stores in 28 states, emerged from Chapter 11 bankruptcy in August and reported a profit of $0.17 a share in its third quarter ended October 31 versus a net loss of $0.40 a share one year ago.
"It is now time for an infusion of aggressive new ideas and energy that will further restore the company's vitality," Larkins said.
Larkins has been with the company for 21 years and has served as its chief executive since 1986.
